referenceSources.description:
A red-and-white Peugeot 406 Coupé Silhouette stands on a racetrack, its wide rear bumper and large spoiler accentuating the competition-focused design. Dual exhaust pipes peek beneath the Pirelli-branded rear valance, while the tubular chassis and fiberglass bodywork hint at its SuperTouring pedigree.

This image complements a detailed online catalog of fiberglass body kits for the Peugeot 406 Coupé, which includes basic, wide (+25 mm), "Peugeot Nîmes," and "Silhouette" tubular chassis versions. The site lists reference codes, descriptions, and prices for each kit, along with polycarbonate window options. Technical data and racing history of the Silhouette model—chassis by ORECA, central V6 engine, and Eric Helary’s championship entries—provide context for the car’s specialized build.
